thread:
matt: Hey team — opening a quick ping. PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/8621 modifies the routing config to add cost-aware fallbacks. This is gated on the design in RFC-523 (https://docs.redwood.ai/rfcs/523-cost-aware-routing). I need architecture eyes before we merge — hoping for a lightweight ack today so we can include this in the 1.42.0 release cut.

priya: @matt thanks — skimmed the RFC earlier. Quick q: does this change the order of fallback candidates or only add a cost filter? need to know SLO impact surface.

matt: It adds a cost_score field and a filter step; ordering stays the same unless cost_score ties. So primary route selection is unchanged unless no route meets the cost threshold. SLOs: latency unaffected for matches, could cause a fallback to higher-latency model when cost threshold is strict. I'm adding a canary that keeps default threshold off.

alex: Can you paste the config diff inline? quick look helps.

matt: Sure — snippet from the PR:

```
routes:
  - name: default
    match: "*"
    fallback_policy:
      type: cost_threshold
      cost_score: 0.7
      allow_variant_fallback: true
```

matt: The PR also wires this into the router config parsing and adds a feature flag `cost_fallback_enabled` for canarying.

priya: Two asks before I can +1: 1) add a note in the RFC about SLO regression thresholds and rollback criteria, and 2) include canary rollout plan in the PR description (percent, duration, metrics: p95 latency, error-rate, cost per 1k tokens).

matt: Will update RFC and PR now. adding rollout block: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 24h with automatic rollback if p95 latency increases >5% or error-rate +0.5%.

sam: Also pls add a short test that verifies router chooses same primary route when cost_score not set (backwards compatibility). We had a bug last time.

matt: good call. added unit test and pushed. CI: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/128912 — all green except a flakey e2e that is unrelated.

ci-bot: build #128912 completed: success :white_check_mark:

maya: I can do arch review after lunch, but that should be fine. @priya can you skim the updated RFC? :eyes:

priya: On it. If I don't catch major concerns within 3 hours, feel free to merge once maya +1s and sam's test is green. @matt add the RFC link to the PR description so it's discoverable.

matt: done — RFC link is now first line of PR description and rollback criteria added. pinging @maya and @priya for final:

matt: @maya @priya any last blockers? :slightly_smiling_face:

maya: No blockers from me, leaving a small nit on wording. +1 on arch grounds.

priya: Read through — RFC update looks good, SLOs and rollback are reasonable. +1 from me.

matt: thanks all — merging after final CI flake re-run. Will back out if telemetry shows issues during canary. :rocket:
